title: Per-model activation stitching and sanity-checks for mixed-precision calibration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a robust calibration pipeline that stitches activation distributions across sequence lengths and batch sizes, applies per-model heuristics for outlier handling, and produces reproducible INT8/FP8 profiles with automated sanity checks. This ticket addresses observed accuracy regressions caused by rare activation outliers and mismatched scaling across layers for Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families. The deliverable is a calibration job (K8s job + runner) which emits a profile bundle, a set of deterministic sanity metrics, and a gating signal for rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration job can produce profile bundles for Llama-2-70B, Mistral-7B-Instruct, and Qwen-7B within our CI runner in <= 45 minutes (on calibration pod), using 2k-sequence calibration corpus.

Generated INT8 and FP8 profiles include: per-layer clip thresholds (percentiles), stitch map for sequence-length normalization, and a numeric sanity report (moved-perplexity, token-level mismatch rate) stored in S3.
Rollout gating metrics: regression < 0.5% token-level perplexity change and < 1% occurrence of outlier-triggered fallback events on a golden prompt set of 500 prompts.
Automation: PR to runtime that consumes the profile and toggles per-layer re-scaling rules must be merged and a canary run executed in staging with no SLO breaches.
Documentation: Confluence doc with calibration recipe, recommended model-specific heuristics, and troubleshooting checklist is published and linked from the profile artifact metadata.
steps: 1) Define calibration corpus: 2k representative sequences per model family (mix of short/med/long), store as s3://redwood-calib/corpora/{model}/

2) Data profiler: run activation histogram collector across 3 sequence-length slices (32, 256, 1024) and batch-size slices (1, 8, 32) with KV cache warming; emit per-layer histograms and per-head stats.
3) Stitching: compute sequence-length normalization factors per-layer by aligning percentiles (p99, p999, p9999) across slices; derive a stitching map and a fallback conservative clip for tails.

4) Per-model heuristics: apply special cases (Llama: early-layer channel clipping at p9999; Mistral: wider mid-layer threshold + per-attention head scale; Qwen: rotary/position-dependent normalization and stricter output-token head clipping).
5) Produce profile bundle: JSON manifest with version, model hash, per-layer dtype suggestion (INT8/FP8), clip percentiles, scale factors, and sanity-check metrics.
6) Validation: run accuracy harness on golden prompts and 100 withheld eval sequences; collect logits distance, token-level mismatch, and generation BLEU/ROUGE where applicable.
7) Report and gate: upload artifacts to S3, populate dashboard (runtime/quant-calib) and set rollback flag if gating thresholds exceeded.
8) Runtime integration: merge PR that maps profile fields to runtime layer scaling logic; run staging canary and capture latency and token SLOs.
9) Post-mortem: capture any regressions and iterate heuristics; add failing prompts to negative test set in repo.
calibration_results: Preliminary run (Llama-2-70B) - 2026-02-28: 2k corpus, 3 slices - p99 clipping reduced peak 128-bit activations by 22% and reduced INT8 accuracy regressions from 2.1% to 0.6% on golden prompts.
Preliminary run (Mistral-7B-Instruct) - 2026-03-03: mid-layer scale factor applied (+8% nominal) improved token logit alignment; FP8 profiles maintained <0.3% perplexity delta.
Preliminary run (Qwen-7B) - 2026-03-06: rotary-aware normalization decreased tail spike frequency by ~60%; required head-level fallback on 3 attention heads.
Known limitations: rare long-context (>4096) sequences still show sporadic single-token spikes; flagged for follow-up (ENG-14288).
